svg.aria-label: Three ways to play. On this PC: a server inside the launcher keeps the logins and the records in one file on this PC. Another server: the launcher and the game on your PC log in on a server someone runs, with an ID and a password from its owner. Offline: no server; everyone plays with NO ID CARD, and no records are kept.
